backend/main.mo: Main actor defining all data types (UserProfile, ExpenseEntry, PermissionRequest, Message, StudyMaterial, etc.) and including authorization and storage mixins with migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining the old actor schema with all data structures for upgrading from previous versions of the application state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: problems solved widget, AI-powered chat analysis with remedy suggestions, and AI remedy toggle control.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration files with implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color palette defining CSS custom properties for light and dark modes with warm family-friendly tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, theme color configuration, manifest link, and apple touch icon references.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, and display settings for FamilyConnect application.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls with offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component with TanStack Router setup, automatic onboarding redirection for users without profiles, and route definitions for all pages.
frontend/src/components/AIConflictAnalys: Analyzes family chat messages to detect conflicts (homework, screen time, curfew) and provides parliamentary-style remedies and recommendations. Includes manual refresh and displays conflict descriptions with formal suggested resolutions.
Displays study tips and performance insights from uploaded materials, showing AI-generated recommendations with analysis levels (basic/intermediate/advanced) and suggested remedies. Shows loading states and empty states when no data is available.
frontend/src/components/ChatWidget.tsx: Draggable chat widget supporting group and private messaging with text, grocery lists, and social media links. Includes message type selection, recipient picker for private chats, and position persistence.
frontend/src/components/DoubtClearingInt: Educational Q&A interface where users can ask questions and receive AI-generated answers. Displays conversation history with timestamps and allows marking problems as resolved.
Analyzes weekly expenses across fees, groceries, and other categories, generating personalized insights and warnings based on spending patterns and percentages. Provides tips for categories exceeding thresholds.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseChart.tsx: Visualizes weekly expenses as horizontal bar charts for fees, groceries, and other categories with percentages and totals. Shows loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseInput.tsx: Form component for parents to add family expenses with category selection (fees, groceries, other) and amount input, using React Query mutations and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/FamilyMemberGrid: Displays a grid of family members (parents and children) with avatars, names, and role badges, fetched from the user profile query.
frontend/src/components/FightsCreatedWid: Card widget showing the count of detected family conflicts with inline editing capability to manually adjust the counter value.
frontend/src/components/FightsSolvedWidg: Card widget displaying resolved family conflicts count with inline editing functionality to update the counter manually.
frontend/src/components/HappinessMeter.t: Visual meter component showing family happiness score as a percentage with color-coded icons (smile/meh/frown) and progress bar based on family interactions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper providing header with app branding, authentication button, navigation bar with icons for all major sections (dashboard, media, reminders, locations, chat, education, settings), and Internet Identity integration.
frontend/src/components/PermissionApprov: React component for parents to view and approve/deny permission requests from children, displaying pending requests with activity type, reason, and timestamp, and polling for updates every 5 seconds.
frontend/src/components/PermissionReques: React component allowing children to submit permission requests to their parents by selecting an activity type (go out, play games, watch YouTube), choosing a parent, and providing a reason.
frontend/src/components/ProblemsSolvedWi: Dashboard widget displaying the total count of family conflicts and educational problems successfully resolved, with a trophy icon and loading state.
frontend/src/components/ShareApp.tsx: Dialog component for sharing the FamilyConnect app URL with family members, featuring a copy-to-clipboard button and instructions for onboarding new users.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatWidget.ts: React hook managing chat widget state (open/closed and horizontal position) with localStorage persistence for maintaining state across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook providing Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, messages, expenses, locations, educational data, and family relationships with comprehensive TypeScript types.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, family-friendly color palette for both light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Chat interface supporting group and private messaging with multiple message types (text, grocery lists, social media links), AI conflict analysis toggle, and real-time message display with family member selection.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard displaying role-specific widgets including happiness meter, problems solved, permission management, AI conflict analysis, expense tracking, and family member grid with different views for parents and children.
frontend/src/pages/EducationalHub.tsx: Educational interface with tabs for uploading question papers and answer scripts, viewing materials, AI-powered analysis results, and a doubt-clearing interface with progress tracking for file uploads.
frontend/src/pages/LocationSharing.tsx: Location sharing page that allows users to share their current GPS coordinates with family members and view family locations using browser geolocation API.
frontend/src/pages/MediaGallery.tsx: Media gallery for uploading and displaying photos and videos with descriptions, upload progress tracking, and profile-based attribution using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.tsx: Onboarding page that handles user profile creation with role selection (parent/child), validates family invitation tokens from URL parameters, and redirects authenticated users to the main app after setup.
frontend/src/pages/Reminders.tsx: Reminders page that displays family reminders sorted by due date, allows creating new reminders with datetime selection, and shows status badges (Overdue/Due Soon/Upcoming) based on due date proximity.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page managing user profiles, family connections (parent/child relationships), invitation link generation, role changes, and AI remedy feature toggle with persistent preference storage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions for managing parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (including warm palette), typography, container queries, animations, and design tokens using OKLCH color space for the UI theme system.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document defining FamilyConnect as a family communication app with AI-powered chat analysis, problem remedies using parliamentary language, solved problems widget, and AI toggle feature.
